TASK: Organize all VLC under one folder, reinstall, combine playlists, add all enhancements, and launch.

1. Kill all VLC processes
2. Copy all VLC data (playlists, scripts, configs, plugins) to C:\Users\BASEDGOD\Desktop\VLC_ABRASAX\
